title: Summadda iyo xiriiriyaha
description: Xiriiriyaha, magaca app-ka iyo calaamadda u gaarka ah madrasadaada. Shaqaalaha fura xiriiriyahan waxay arkayaan calaamaddaada, app-ka ay rakibaanna wuxuu muujinayaa magacaaga iyo astaantaada.
appNameHint: Wuxuu ka muuqdaa hoosta astaanta app-ka ee taleefannada iyo tabka biraawsarka. Ka dhig mid gaaban (ugu badnaan {max} xaraf).
slugHint: Xarfo yaryar, tirooyin iyo jiitin (-), 3–40 xaraf.
slugInvalid: Isticmaal 3–40 xaraf oo yaryar, tirooyin ama jiitin, kuna bilow kuna dhammee xaraf ama tiro.
slugReserved: Magacan xiriiriyaha waa la xijiyay. Fadlan dooro mid kale.
slugTaken: Madrasad kale ayaa horay u isticmaashay magacan xiriiriyaha.
slugChangeWarning: Beddelidda xiriiriyaha waxay jebinaysaa kii hore: app-yada la rakibay iyo xiriiriyayaasha la wadaagay way shaqayn waayayaan, shaqaaluhuna waxay u baahan doonaan xiriiriyaha cusub.
notSetUpHint: Hoos ka deji magaca xiriiriyaha si shaqaalahaagu u isticmaalaan bogga galitaanka iyo app-ka u gaarka ah madrasadaada.
logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP ama SVG, ugu badnaan 5 MB. Calaamad labajibbaaran oo gadaal hufan leh ayaa ugu wanaagsan.
logoRemoved: Calaamadda caadiga ah ee MMS ayaa mar kale la isticmaalayaa.
logoErrorType: Nooca faylkan lama taageero. Fadlan isticmaal PNG, JPG, WebP ama SVG.
logoErrorSize: Faylku wuu ka weyn yahay 5 MB.
logoErrorDecode: Sawirkan lama akhrin karin. Fadlan isku day fayl kale.
saveFailed: Summadda lama kaydin karin. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
uploadFailed: Calaamadda lama soo gelin karin. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
